name: opencode-parity-ignores-git
title: Parity test enumerates git-ignored .opencode paths
description: Created 2026-08-18. tests/test_generated_parity.py:1361 asserts facts about the working tree where it means facts about the git index. It fails when .opencode/package.json exists -- a path .opencode/.gitignore:2 deliberately ignores and CONTRIBUTING tells developers to create -- and behind that assertion its opencode_module_sources glob at :187 descends into the git-ignored .opencode/node_modules and reports vendored packages' own imports as pack external imports. Local make check is red for any developer with .opencode installed; CI is green only because its checkout never runs the install step. Test-only fix: enumerate tracked payload from git.
creator: sdelmas
